This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the game [[Pokémon Box Ruby & Sapphire]] for the [[Nintendo GameCube]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Nintendo]] and [[Game Freak]]. All names are given in Western order.
